exposure: ST-segment analysis of the fetal electrocardiogram
initiation period (first 2 years) vs subsequent usage period (next 9 years)
outcome: rate of fetal scalp blood sampling
cohort: 42,146 deliveries at Turku University Hospital, Turku, Finland
finding: The study found that the rates of metabolic acidosis and operative deliveries decreased after the initial implementation period of ST analysis.
